FTMO Challenge
In the 2-Step FTMO Challenge you start with the FTMO Challenge. It’s a test of your trading skills with clear, structured rules. Your goal is to show a consistent and responsible trading approach.
Choose Your FTMO Challenge Size
Select from $10,000, $25,000, $50,000, $100,000, or $200,000 simulated accounts.
Start FTMO Challenge
Trade and Achieve a 10% Profit Target
Example: With a $100,000 simulated account, reach $10,000 Profit Target without exceeding 5% ($5,000) Maximum Daily Loss or 10% ($10,000) Maximum Loss.
Show All Objectives
Verification
Verification is your second phase. You’ll follow the same rules as before, but with a lower Profit Target. This stage is designed to verify consistency.
Continue with Your Simulated Account
You’ll use the same account size as in the FTMO Challenge.
Trade and Achieve 5% Profit Target
Reach the 5% Profit Target while staying within the same risk limits.

FTMO Rewards Account
Welcome to the FTMO Rewards Account for 2-Step FTMO Challenge. After successfully completing the Identity Verification and consenting to the Signal Provider Agreement, you become an FTMO Verified Prop Trader.
Congratulations! You’re Now an FTMO Verified Prop Trader.
You keep trading with simulated capital, but now you earn a share of your simulated profits.
Show Your Best in Every Trade

The FTMO business model (“FTMO US”) is operated through a partnership between FTMO and OANDA. JV Prop Corporation is a US-registered FTMO Group company responsible for the provision of the Evaluation Process (FTMO Challenge and Verification) and OANDA Prop US Corporation is a US registered OANDA group company (owned by OANDA Global Corporation) responsible for the provision of the FTMO Rewards Account (Signal Provider Program). While certain infrastructure on which FTMO US services are offered is provided by OANDA Corporation (“OC”), you do not have any client relationship with OC when participating in FTMO US services and therefore will not benefit from any regulatory protections afforded to OC customers. None of the services offered is subject to oversight by any financial regulator. This service is only available to residents of the US and legal entities incorporated in the US. Both Evaluation Process and FTMO Rewards Account offer access solely to a simulated trading environment.

Both Evaluation Process and FTMO Rewards Account offer access solely to a simulated trading environment.

FTMO Challenge
In the 2-Step FTMO Challenge you start with the FTMO Challenge. It’s a test of your trading skills with clear, structured rules. Your goal is to show a consistent and responsible trading approach.

Select from $10,000, $25,000, $50,000, $100,000, or $200,000 simulated accounts.
Start FTMO Challenge
Trade and Achieve a 10% Profit Target
Example: With a $100,000 simulated account, reach $10,000 Profit Target without exceeding 5% ($5,000) Maximum Daily Loss or 10% ($10,000) Maximum Loss.

Verification
Verification is your second phase. You’ll follow the same rules as before, but with a lower Profit Target. This stage is designed to verify consistency.
Continue with Your Simulated Account
You’ll use the same account size as in the FTMO Challenge.

Reach the 5% Profit Target while staying within the same risk limits.

Congratulations! You’re Now an FTMO Verified Prop Trader.
You keep trading with simulated capital, but now you earn a share of your simulated profits.
Show Your Best in Every Trade
There’s no Profit Target apart from your own. Just follow the risk limits and earn your rewards.

Request withdrawals using the approved payment methods.

The FTMO business model (“FTMO US”) is operated through a partnership between FTMO and OANDA. JV Prop Corporation is a US-registered FTMO Group company responsible for the provision of the Evaluation Process (FTMO Challenge and Verification) and OANDA Prop US Corporation is a US registered OANDA group company (owned by OANDA Global Corporation) responsible for the provision of the FTMO Rewards Account (Signal Provider Program). While certain infrastructure on which FTMO US services are offered is provided by OANDA Corporation (“OC”), you do not have any client relationship with OC when participating in FTMO US services and therefore will not benefit from any regulatory protections afforded to OC customers. None of the services offered is subject to oversight by any financial regulator. This service is only available to residents of the US and legal entities incorporated in the US. Both Evaluation Process and FTMO Rewards Account offer access solely to a simulated trading environment.

Your Free Trial Journey

Treat your Free Trial like the real thing. Same conditions, same objectives, no fee. Build the discipline here, then use it to earn up to 90% of your simulated profits as an FTMO Verified Prop Trader.

Set up your Free Trial
Choose your product, account type, size, and platform, then start. Your setup is ready in seconds.
Build your trading habits
Your setup is locked in and the Free Trial is now active. Start steady, find your rhythm and trading style that works for you.
Trading Period
You have 14 days to trade and test your strategy. Focus on one idea and trade it well.
Meet the Trading Objectives
Meet the Trading Objectives set for the product you chose. Only 1-Step and 2-Step Free Trial accounts carry a Profit Target, and it's halved for the Free Trial.
End of the Free Trial
Your Free Trial runs for 14 days. Meet every Trading Objective and you pass. Breach one and it ends right there. Either way, review your data and go again, as many times as you like.
Choose Your Path
You have completed your Free Trial. When you are comfortable with your trading approach, choose the product that best fits your style.
Practise first. Commit later.
